description: This Kotlin source file defines the 'HomeFragment' class for an Android TV application UI, which displays a dashboard with multiple rows including hero metrics, workout lists, progress charts, badges, and profile options. The fragment manages UI setup, row building with various adapters and presenters, and handles user interactions such as item clicks to navigate to other screens.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: An Android TV UI fragment that displays the app's homepage with multiple rows including hero metrics, workouts, progress, badges, and profile options, using Leanback library components.

classes.name: HomeFragment.StringPresenter
classes.description: A presenter class used to create simple clickable cards for navigation shortcuts like Profile, Goals, and Setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up the UI, builds the data rows, and registers event listeners.

methods.name: setupUi
methods.description: Configures the UI appearance of the fragment, including title, colors, and search button.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Constructs the rows for display: hero metrics, daily workouts, recommended workouts, progress chart, badges, and profile shortcuts.

methods.name: setupEventListeners
methods.description: Defines actions to perform when user interacts with items, such as navigating to profile, goals, or starting playback.

methods.name: openOnboarding
methods.description: Starts the onboarding activity for initial setup.
